question_note: One iteration axis. Other CatBoost controls stay fixed. Confirmation seeds are not fit.
interpolation_rule: A cell interpolates when the training residual L2 norm divided by the training response L2 norm is <= 1e-8.
tie_rule: The smallest iteration wins ties in clean MSE.
bracket_rule: bracketed only if some iteration is below the tolerance and a strictly smaller iteration is above it. Otherwise not_identifiable. Clean risk does not enter this rule.
